description: A young British woman, early twenties, with a light, quick, bright voice and a southern English accent that is friendly rather than posh. Energetic without being breathless, laughs easily, lifts at the end of a good sentence.
style: Upbeat and quick, with a smile. Lean into questions.
refText: Right, so here's the plan: we get the early train, grab coffee at the station, and we're on the hill before anyone else is awake. Honestly, you'll thank me when you see the view.
